global_blind_spots: Scope is USDC on eip155:8453, XRP on xrpl:0, and USDC on solana:mainnet. Any other rail a door declares is named per-row and not counted.
The Solana probe reads CURRENT BALANCE ONLY and can never return ZERO_OBSERVED — an empty or absent token account is UNKNOWN, not evidence of non-payment.
Impl A and impl B share the Blockscout index. They fail independently at the DERIVATION layer only; an indexer-level fault hits both and they will agree on being wrong.
/addresses/{a}/counters is never read: measured 2026-09-14 it returns 0 for all 8 doors known to have been paid.
A USDC balance of zero is not evidence of non-payment — a swept payment reads identically.
payTo mutation over time is not detectable from a single observation.

SAMPLING: unless --slugs was used, this is the NEWEST N of the directory, not a random or complete sample. Newest listings are the least likely to publish a workable payTo or to have been paid. Do not read the tally as an ecosystem rate.
stated_before_reveal: These are our readings, not ground truth. If SCVD reads something we missed, we were wrong and it gets published as a miss.
Two of these five (daxpt, humanmirror) are doors our own instrument previously got wrong. They are included on purpose.
